about_the_game:
Step into the ultimate test to become the world's greatest robot pilot! This fully virtual reality trial will push your control skills, composure, and spatial awareness to their absolute limits. Of course, you can quit anytime… that is, until an unexpected glitch traps you in the virtual world.

Ultimate Control Machine is a 3D platformer played using 30 different controllers.

As you progress, the way you control your character will change periodically. Here are a few examples:

  • Standard WASD controls

  • Use the mouse right/left click to change direction and the scroll wheel to adjust speed

  • Press Q to step forward with your left foot, P to step with your right foot

  • Operate a virtual keyboard on-screen with your mouse

  • Move a virtual player across a virtual-on-virtual keyboard, which then triggers movement for your real player

The only way to wake up from this endless nightmare of virtual reality: reach the end of the world.

Navigate winding mazes and obstacles, evade terrifying destructive machines charging toward you, and make your way to the edge of this world! But beware—the broken physics engine of this distorted virtual reality has no intention of going easy on you. Whatever you touch, wherever you step, you’ll be bounced away. Back, further back, even further back…

This is a highly challenging platformer where a single mistake can wipe out all progress and send you back to the very beginning.

Test your limits!
